resolved_conflicts.explanation: The survey says the wood towers named here were replaced by steel in the 1940s or 1950s, yet Tennessee Landforms and the 2014 extant list both show a standing Moores Switch tower. The sources do not say whether the standing tower is the steel replacement.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: one survey passage on wood construction and replacement (cites an undated TDF record), one 2014 extant list entry, and one undated Tennessee Landforms row. No build date, builder or height found, so no replacement event is recorded (the decade is not narrow enough to date it). The 798 ft figure is an elevation; it is not used as tower height. The record's FD1528 looks like an NGS datasheet ID (Landforms says it draws on NGS datasheets); not verified. The survey prose spells it Moore's Switch; its table spells it Moores Switch. The Wikipedia Moore Lookout Tower is a Mississippi tower and was not used. No Forest Lookouts or NHLR page for this tower turned up in the cache. No photos found. Two WebSearch calls used.
